name: com.pixygon.buildtools
description: One-click multi-platform build + ship for Pixygon Unity games: BunnyCDN upload with cache purge, automatic patch-version bump, self-describing WebGL build manifest, and macOS code-signing + notarization. Provides an in-editor 'Build & Ship ALL' (cross-domain-reload queue, no need to close Unity) and a batchmode ship.sh CLI. GameName auto-derives from productName, so adoption is near-zero-config.
